shared_elements: standing human figures shown in profile
row/procession of figures at the same scale along a single register
figures with one arm extended forward, holding or presenting small objects
low-relief outline carving with minimal interior modelling
justification: Both surfaces show a single register of similarly sized human figures in strict profile, striding or standing in a line with arms extended to present or carry small objects, rendered as flat outlined low relief with little interior detail. The differences are substantial: A includes a large animal led on a rein, a tree, and framing bands of rosette ornament in a long horizontal frieze, while B is a compact arched panel with figures facing one another in an offering gesture beneath a block of script-like signs and no animals, plants or ornamental border.
